720	Rabbi Akiva, peace be upon him, was imprisoned by the Romans because he taught Torah in public.	O Rabi Akiva, que a paz esteja sobre ele, foi preso pelos romanos porque ensinava Torá em público.
721	That was his offense. If only that were our offense.	Essa foi a sua transgressão. Quem dera fosse a nossa.
722	All he did was teach Torah in public.	Tudo o que ele fez foi ensinar Torá em público.
723	They didn't catch him stealing, they didn't catch him with bribes, they didn't catch him giving money, they didn't catch him with anything	Não o pegaram roubando, não o pegaram com suborno, não o pegaram dando dinheiro, não o pegaram com nada.
724	at all.	Nada.
725	Not with women, not with men, not with children, nothing.	Nem com mulheres, nem com homens, nem com crianças, nada.
726	What was his offense?	Qual foi a sua transgressão?
727	He taught Torah in public.	Ensinar Torá em público.
728	And that was the time of Hadrian, "may the name of the wicked rot," who hated religion, hated the Jews,	E era a época de Adriano, "o nome dos ímpios apodrecerá", que odiava a religião, odiava os judeus,
729	hated Judaism, and hated the ruins of the Temple too.	odiava o judaísmo e odiava até as ruínas do Templo.

731	Interestingly, someone came to me from Monsey, and he said he spent a million shekels.	Curiosamente, alguém veio a mim de Monsey e disse que gastou um milhão de shekels.

734	of the Temple Mount.	do Monte do Templo.

739	That means that what the Romans did, they hated the Temple so much that they didn't just destroy it, they	Ou seja, o que os romanos fizeram: odiavam tanto o Templo que não apenas o destruíram,
740	destroyed it, and then the stones remained, the markings remained, and they filled everything with earth	destruíram, e então ficaram as pedras, ficaram as marcações, e eles encheram tudo de terra

744	have to wait for Mashiach to show us the place of the altar in order to bring offerings.	preciso esperar o Mashiach nos mostrar o lugar do altar para oferecer sacrifícios.

746	the place of the altar.	o lugar do altar.

748	Anyway, Rabbi Akiva, this was his punishment at the hands of Turnus Rufus the wicked.	Enfim, Rabi Akiva, esse foi o seu castigo pelas mãos de Turnus Rufus, o ímpio.
